landing.heroBody: Scan the rack QR, enter the quantity, done in 10 seconds. Stock updates on the dashboard instantly, and every pick is recorded permanently.
landing.featuresBody: No long training, no extra app. Just a browser on a phone.
landing.featureLogBody: Every stock change becomes a log row that cannot be edited or deleted.
landing.featureOfflineBody: Picks queue up and sync automatically when the signal returns.
landing.featureLiveBody: Stock changed on one phone appears on the supervisor dashboard within a second.
landing.featureSheetsBody: Sheets is a read window and a master-data editor — not the primary database.
landing.how1: Find the item on the dashboard to see its rack location.
landing.how2: Scan the rack QR — the phone camera is enough.
landing.how3: Enter quantity and reason. Stock updates and is logged under your name.
